Default (a), owned by the HBM die owner as an RTL class fix; not done in this lane.

### HBM-HUBMESH-3.md
- 2026-10-31 07:19 PDT CLAIM/PROGRESS [HBM-HUBMESH-3] successor of HUBMESH-2 (parked 06:44). No live HUBMESH-2 jobs to adopt (ot-run/docker checked). Task 1 GRT-0183: mechanism found in the OR 26Q3 source (maze3D.cpp: 3D maze planar moves need usage+cost<=cap AND layer in the net's clock range M8-M9; heap underflow = no legal planar exit). Every failing pin (a2 NW P55/A + N22/Y, a2 NE P186/A + N85/Y, a3r NW N22/Y, a3r NE N85/Y, v1 B N197/A) is a BUFx24 whose pin gcell row overlaps an M8 PG stripe (y = k*4.32, so the 'y=540 row' = 4.32*125) AND whose gcell column sits under an M9 PG stripe/strap band: M8 has ~1 track left there (0.48-um stripe in a 0.57-um GRT tile, min-1 rule), M9 none, M2-M7 are outside the clock layer range -> one other edge on that track boxes the pin [CHECKED pin/gcell map; 1-net crop GRT does not reproduce it (3D maze skips the longest 10% of nets and needs 2D overflow 0), so the full-hub GRT is the test]. a3 passed with N22/N85 at the SAME spots: order luck, so the a3 pass is not robust. Fix (opt-in, default bytes unchanged): mesh_form grid.pin_clear_um: no driver/repeater row within 0.6 um of an M8 PG stripe or h-strap band. a3rp = a3r (measured re-balance) + pin_clear 0.6: 0/653 NW and 0/662 NE BUFx24 on stripe rows (a3r 69/90, a3 75/87) [CHECKED]. GRT a3rp NW+NE via ot-run epyc2 (oth-ubuntu-1440217 / -1440216, 07:18, ~25 min).
- 2026-10-31 07:55 PDT RESULT/PARKED [HBM-HUBMESH-3] claude/hbm-hubmesh-3-1031@95bae0db39a (pushed; on HUBMESH-2 df7a817b9). OUTCOME: GRT-0183 root cause found and fixed; the mesh form has still NOT passed 12.25 (contract), and the measured re-balance made the spread worse.
  (1) GRT-0183 ROOT CAUSE [CHECKED source + pin map; fix tested in 2 full-hub GRTs]: in the OR 26Q3 3D maze, a planar move needs usage+cost<=cap on a layer inside the net's range, and clock nets are M8-M9 only. A BUFx24 on a row that overlaps an M8 PG stripe (y=k*4.32 um; 'y=540' = 4.32x125) keeps about 1 M8 track in its 0.57-um GRT tile (crop GRT: PG cuts the original M8 resource 12.7%, the min-1 adjustment rule keeps 1). When the pin's column also sits under an M9 PG stripe or strap band (M9 = 0), one more edge on that track boxes the pin in. Every failing net has such a pin: a2 NW P55/A + N22/Y, a2 NE P186/A + N85/Y, a3r N22/Y and N85/Y, v1 B N197/A. a3 has N22/N85 at the SAME spots but passed: the 3D maze reroutes only the shortest 90% of nets and only when 2D overflow is 0, so pass/fail depends on net order. The a3 pass was luck, not robustness. A 1-net crop does not reproduce it (it never enters the 3D maze). FIX (opt-in mesh_form grid.pin_clear_um, absent = old bytes; 2 new tests, 25 pass): no driver/repeater row within 0.6 um of an M8 PG stripe or an h-strap band (mesh loads exempt, since ck_mesh is not GRT-routed). a3rp = a3r + pin_clear 0.6 has 0/653 and 0/662 BUFx24 on stripe rows (a3r 69/90). GRT EXIT 0 on BOTH hubs where a3r failed on both [CHECKED a3rp/kit/mesh/*/run_grt.log, 26-27 min, congestion total 43/36].

- 2026-10-31 07:56 PDT KV-FN-3: FINDING (real-silicon handshake, for COORD ruling). The peer token service has a defined readiness handshake: a strapped peer sends a CTRL STATUS frame (op 0x21 v2, ready = local_service_ready at bit 153, service epoch 169:154) to the package controller on every ready/epoch change. But a START that arrives before ready is NOT queued or retried: peer_service_fresh false -> sticky fault (qkd_host_ctrl_token_service_packet_collected_mu l.403), cleared only by a token-wrap fence (drained + link reset + retraining) or reset; and the root side's load_cmd broadcasts START without checking service_ready8. So correctness rests on the controller/host waiting for every peer's ready STATUS. RTL OPTION (one line, needs re-signs of hub_Wi): peer holds a START at the rx queue head while not ready instead of faulting, e.g. assign take = count!=0 && !fault && !(ENABLE_TOKEN && !role_root && head_is_peer_START && !(lready && lepoch==epoch)) (bounded by the existing WDOG). DEFAULT (if no ruling in 30 min): no RTL change; bench/controller contract = wait for ready STATUS (implemented in claude/kv-fn-3-1031), recorded as an ABI rule.

Branch claude/plan-icg-model-1026@5a2a795666 (= model-refit 930fa9628d + core-lat-r4 350f81a352 merge + 1 commit): tools/die_plan/core_infra_plan.py (icg_lib_cells, open_subtree, region_reach, gated_leaf_region, OPEN_SUBTREE_CAL, predict_tree times gated_domain + cts_open leaves), core_infra_sta.py (emit_model emits the real ICG master + one CTS root BUFx24 per open domain incl SPEF, combine_arrivals adds the subtree model), 6 new tests; test_core_infra/_plan/_master_plan/_r3/_network/_wire 76 PASS + 1 pre-existing tkinter FAIL (epyc1 has no tkinter). MODEL: ICG = liberty CLK->GCLK NLDM at 1 BUFx24 load next to the gate (measured ICG->first buffer median 1.1 um qxpq / 2.2 um bf_col); subtree from root-buffer pin = stage x ceil(log24 N) + g x D (D = driver -> farthest region corner), min/max = mean -/+ lo/hi x D. CAL (fit once, 1,043 single-level gated domains, equal core weight): TT 24.93 ps/stage + 0.636 ps/um (lo 0.092 hi 0.270), FF 19.06 + 0.518 (0.086/0.239). A gate needs region_rect_um or island_rect_um (refused otherwise).
